hostname.description: The hostname to use for the envelope sender and From: header if MAILHOST is not set. Corresponds to the system machine name or MAILHOST env var.

sender_name.description: The name to use in the From: header if -F, MAILNAME, and NAME env vars are not set. Corresponds to -F / MAILNAME / NAME.

sender_user.description: The user ID to use for the envelope sender if -f and MAILSUSER/MAILUSER/LOGNAME/LOGUSER are not set. Corresponds to the fallback user ID logic in rmail.

service_dsn_options.description: Default Delivery Status Notification options. Comma-separated list of never, success, fail, delay. Corresponds to the default behavior for -N.

service_security_level.description: Minimum security level for remote delivery. Must be 'NONE' or 'STARTTLS'. Corresponds to -S option.

local_domains.description: List of local domains. While rmail(1) is a command-line wrapper, this configuration is typically required by the underlying Courier sendmail wrapper to determine local delivery. Corresponds to the 'local' module's domain list.
